d: Dusty rose hair is styled into two low pigtails with blunt-cut bangs and held by small orange spherical hair ties. The eyes are a matching dusty rose shade with a wide, surprised expression, set on a youthful face with a childlike maturity. A petite build is dressed in a short-sleeved white sailor shirt with a navy blue collar, a navy blue pleated mini-skirt, and brown thigh straps. A small white rabbit sits atop a large, olive-drab military equipment pack held in the arms, while a red-and-yellow circular badge is pinned to the chest.
